cases.title: Create a new note by clicking the add button
cases.description: Click the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button") and verify that a new note <div> element with class "note" is appended to the body, containing a visible, empty textarea (data-testid="note-textarea").

cases.title: Support multiple rapid clicks on the add note button
cases.description: Perform multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button and verify that each click creates a separate note containing its own distinct textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown rendering in note input
cases.description: Input Markdown text into the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") and verify that the content is dynamically rendered with proper HTML formatting in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") and saved to local storage.

cases.title: Handle invalid Markdown syntax gracefully
cases.description: Input invalid Markdown (such as unmatched **) into the textarea and verify that the app does not crash and displays raw input when exiting edit mode using the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Immediate edit mode upon creation and mode toggling
cases.description: Create a note and verify it immediately enters edit mode with a visible textarea and hidden main content area (data-testid="note-main"). Toggle between edit and view modes using the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button") and verify visibility changes accordingly.

cases.title: Delete a note from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Click the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") on a note and verify that the targeted note is immediately removed from the DOM and its entry is removed from localStorage.

cases.title: Retrieve and display saved notes from localStorage on page load
cases.description: Populate localStorage with notes containing content and empty notes, load the page, and verify that notes are correctly rendered with appropriate view or edit mode defaults, tools, and data-testid attributes.

cases.title: Handle empty localStorage on page load
cases.description: Load the webpage when localStorage is empty and verify that no notes are shown.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases cover all requirements comprehensively, including DOM manipulation, mode toggling, markdown rendering, error handling for invalid markdown, persistence via localStorage, and initialization states. No blockers or untestable scenarios were identified.
All cases and expected behaviors align correctly with the requirements. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1 covers clicking the add note button (id="add", class="add", data-testid="add-note-button") to append a note <div> with class "note" and a visible empty textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), supporting multiple rapid clicks. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2 covers editing markdown in the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), rendering dynamically in data-testid="note-main", handling complex/invalid markdown gracefully, reverting to raw input on edit exit via data-testid="edit-note-button", and persisting changes in local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3 covers page load note creation, immediate edit mode upon creation with visible textarea and hidden data-testid="note-main", switching view/edit modes using data-testid="edit-note-button", and auto-saving to local storage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4 covers deleting a note via data-testid="delete-note-button", removing it from the DOM and localStorage. Requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5 covers retrieving saved notes from localStorage on page load, rendering div.note with tools containing data-testid="edit-note-button" and data-testid="delete-note-button", data-testid="note-main", and textarea, defaulting to view mode for notes with content and edit mode for empty notes, and handling empty localStorage.
